advance_rule: Advance a grid point to scheduling-lever evaluation only when it is mandatory-feasible, oracle value is positive, the oracle-normalized aggregate gap is at least 5%, and oracle value exceeds recovery-first in each of the four frozen calibration windows.
analysis_role: Find, before any policy implementation, whether an exact recovery-order oracle exceeds a certificate-preserving recovery-first baseline by at least 5% on frozen BurstGPT arrivals mapped to Qwen bounds.
batch_rule: At each P180 decision, order requests that arrived after the prior decision and by the current decision by (arrival_ms, source_order); screen only the first N fixed by ai_units_per_epoch. No carry, future arrival, realized service, or policy outcome affects the batch.
exclusion_rule: No trace window, request within the fixed batch rule, topology, outcome, or grid point may be excluded.
holdout_rule: Calibration only. Do not open or create a confirmatory workload holdout in this screen.
slo_rationale: BurstGPT supplies arrivals and token sizes but no SLO. 1000 ms retains the prior interactive sensitivity; 250 ms spans roughly two P180 decisions; 50 and 100 ms are explicitly synthetic near-real-time expiration sensitivities for AI outputs consumed within a current radio-control horizon. They are not BurstGPT or production claims.
stop_rule: One deterministic screen of every grid point; retain positive, tied, infeasible, and zero-value rows.
